comments.text: Nihao! Watching this at 9:18 PM on a Saturday from Phu Tho, Vietnam 🇻🇳. As a documentary video editor, I'm absolutely blown away by the visual pacing and scriptwriting here. The B-roll in image_3c5e11.jpg capturing the glowing tour boats against the Shanghai skyline perfectly anchors the transition into the city's $12 billion nighttime economy [05:47]. You didn't just show the lights; you explained the energy behind them. To answer your question [18:41]: The concept of "Tang Ping" (lying flat) and "Neijuan" (involution) [07:39] surprised me the most. It's fascinating to see youth redefining success in such a fast-paced society. For the next video, I'm guessing South Korea! 🇨🇳🎥
